review:
The fisherman goes to Antarctica, complete with penguins. Three scatters give 10 free spins, and two on the top rows give a respin for another shot.

Before the bonus, you open Christmas gifts for modifiers – extra spins, assured cash, fishermen already collected or removing the lowest cash value. Every fourth fisherman adds 10 spins and a multiplier that can reach 50x – far higher than most of the series – and a random waterfall can flood the reels with cash. 96.07% RTP.
